title: JmapError constructors for SetError-only types
description: jmap_types::JmapError has constructors not_found, too_large, over_quota, rate_limit, invalid_patch, will_destroy, invalid_properties, singleton, already_exists (with existing_id) for RFC 8620 §5.3/§5.4 SetError types, which are not method-level errors. After JMAP-wf92.5 they build MethodErrorType::Other. Only too_large/rate_limit have a real caller (calendars Principal/getAvailability, whose draft defines them as method errors) plus a response.rs serialization test. Decide: remove the SetError-only ones (and JmapError.existing_id), or keep.
notes: DECISION Mark 2026-10-22: option (a) remove JmapError constructors not_found, over_quota, invalid_patch, will_destroy, invalid_properties, singleton, already_exists and the existing_id field; keep too_large and rate_limit (calendars Principal/getAvailability uses them as method errors). Check the 4 not_found call sites are tests or convert them correctly. BREAKING.
close_reason: Batch 16 (run wf_a0fdc13e-266): implemented, adversarially verified, full CI green at 17928284
